Dispatch queue, per node shard, per processor control and arena map pool internals.
Rescue accrue, admit, arm, decay averaging and timeout selection details.
Bypass balancing, stall handling, disable and exit propagation sequences.
Exit info layout, error reporting paths and helper worker duties.

findings.text: Scheduler instance starts with overlapping operation tables for processor and compartment identifier forms sharing one storage area, plus a marker for registration form and a marker for life after exit callback that gates program access.

Instance carries arena discovery state for compartment mode with map reference, sub allocation pool and kernel base, plus per processor scratch for mask updates, a shared online mask, and a bitmap recording which optional operations exist.

Dispatch and tuning state combines a hash for named queues, per locality queue shards with optional per shard tables on nested builds, per processor controls, default slice, bypass timing and nesting depth with claim and enable counters, abort and dump markers, batch limit and hierarchy level.

Lifecycle state holds an optional frozen shard count for deferred release, benign racy warning latches, list linkage, strictly increasing nonrecycled identifier, starvation timeout, exit classification with detail block, kernel object, helper worker, disable and exit work items, bypass timer with masks, stall mask, deferred work and trailing ancestor chain.
Nested builds add hash linkage, child and sibling links, group pointer with path and object set, plus linkage and attachment markers.

Task walk cursor bundles a positioning entity, a pinned task with runqueue and flags, a visited count, a list protection marker, and on nested builds group traversal state with subsystem position and iterator.
Enable request carries worker linkage, overlapping pointers for either operation table form with a discriminator, an arena reference to hand over, and a completion status.
Exit message scratch holds a fixed numeric argument array sized by the print helper limit plus a line buffer sized by the exit message limit.
Both operation views keep identical placement through the private member, so shared members are reachable through either view without pointer casts.
Processor form leaves the arena reference empty while identifier form needs one arena shared by all member programs, with sub allocations drawn from a pool keyed at kernel mapping addresses.
Worldwide dispatch storage is divided by locality so contending consumers in pass through mode do not stall each other, with room for finer division if needed.
Active nesting uses a live global for shard count while a frozen per instance copy supports safe deferred reclamation after a later activation rewrites the global.

Two one bit first time warning latches may update concurrently without consequence, the instance number grows without reuse, and a runnable starvation limit in timer ticks triggers error handling when exceeded.
Activation moves among bringing up, active, tearing down and inactive phases, each paired with a lower case readable label.

Task ownership cycles among core owned, travelling toward extension, owned by extension, and travelling back, with a per queuing brand letting the dispatcher test whether a racing removal invalidated its claim.
Brand shift is two, leaving low two bits for ownership phase and remaining bits for brand; zero brand is reserved as invalid and 32 bit builds retain thirty brand bits.
Wake flags reuse fork, remote wake and sync values from core wake set; enqueue low bits reuse wakeup, head and runqueue selected values; dequeue sleep reuses core sleep value.
Enqueue extension places preempt at bit 32, immediate at 33, rescue at 34, requeue marker at 40 and last marker at 41; dequeue extension places core execution at 32 and property change at 33.

High byte of enqueue word is reserved for core internal use, with distinct positions for clearing operation state, priority placement, nesting, worldwide fallback, capability bypass, carried slice use and default refill spanning bits 56 through 62.

Requeue filter occupies low sixteen with any at bit zero and capability revoke at bit one and decision hints at bits 32 and 33 inside a nibble at 32; idle choice uses bit zero for core and bit one for locality; kick uses bits zero through two for idle, preempt and wait; group flags use bits zero through two for online, initialized and nested initialized.

Preempt clears current slice and forces scheduling while implying head placement; immediate keeps a locally queued task either running or returned to the scheduler across save restore and preemption; rescue diverts capability lacking inserts to a progress assured limited path; requeue marks reinsertion after removal; last marks sole runnable needing scheduler driven follow up.

Idle kick assures a full cycle before idling and does nothing when already cycling; preempt kick expires the current extension task; wait kick blocks until that task leaves; idle choice can require sibling idleness or locality; dequeue separates core forced execution from attribute changes; revoke requeue is core originated and not accepted from extension.
Operation invocation preserves runqueue tracking by remembering the prior locked runqueue, installing the supplied one for the call duration when present, then restoring the remembered value.
Compatibility support provides a declaration helper introducing an external marker per function name and a definition helper adding a retained unused empty marker body.
Readable activation labels are published as a table indexed by activation phase.

Rescue tuning is held in file private bandwidth, quantum, saturation step, decay half life and overload grace variables; per runqueue slice is quantum divided by wait depth with empty treated as one, lower bounded by the larger of configured minimum and tick and upper bounded by quantum.

Overload scan ignores empty waiters, recent arrivals and recent ejections on the same processor, then among nested live schedulers selects the highest decayed rescue consumption and fails it with a diagnostic naming usage and waiter identity and delay.

Periodic rescue handling accrues usage and checks overload, starts the next waiter when idle and budget covers a quantum with local placement and conditional reschedule, escalates a long waiting rescue by granting remainder with protection and head preempting placement, then rearms.

Capability notices are coalesced under a per shard lock into mask union and bit union with at most one flight linkage; delivery skips consumption until the update callback exists and the instance is not aborting, snapshots and clears pending state under lock then invokes the callback; seeding after activation queues grants that arrived before liveness.

Capability coalescing serializes on a dedicated raw lock with delivery under interrupt save; rescue overload asserts runqueue ownership and its timer holds runqueue with interrupts masked; parent lookup asserts scheduler table lock while enable work serializes on enable mutex plus table lock with a reference hold on parent.

Subtree takeover walks descendants twice, first invoking child initialization for groups still owned by the parent inside the target and marking progress, then retiring parent linkage and publishing new ownership; failure unwinds only marked groups through child teardown; non nested builds provide a trivial success stub.

Parent discovery rejects double attachment to the same group, parents without nesting support, and insertion above exiting descendants; enabling validates that each affected task is in ready or enabled condition with a one time warning otherwise.

Timer routine serves as rescue period handler bound to its runqueue; nested enable routine serves as worker callback validating global enablement, operation privacy, group lookup and parent before allocating and publishing; hash lookup by group identifier resolves nested instances.

Unpartitioned worldwide consumption risks pass through livelock; delayed rescue service triggers forced failure of the heaviest nested consumer; escalation grants unserved remainder with protection to assure progress; publishing before validation or shard allocation risks null dereference during concurrent revocation.

Dump suppression is guarded by a dedicated dump lock; aborting is consulted with single read semantics to suppress capability callbacks; exit classification is read atomically to skip already exiting candidates.

A static branch records presence of nested schedulers, raised before operation privacy publication so kicks from new programs are gated correctly with matching decrement on deferred free; validation and shard allocation complete before tree linkage publishes the new instance.
Enable path carries an arena reference whose ownership moves into the freshly allocated scheduler rather than duplicating.
